rows.definition: The resolved `fak serve --execution-policy` (production or bringup): whether the GFX1151 device-only refusals apply to this serve, and which of them a bring-up-dedicated node lifted.
rows.distinction: Unlike the per-session model.ExecutionPolicy (device-only or not), it is the launch-time operator policy that decides whether that session policy is installed at all; bringup is admitted only when FAK_BRINGUP_DEDICATED names the served model.

rows.definition: The /healthz execution_policy block a serve publishes under a non-production execution policy: the dedicated model and every device-only refusal token the policy bypassed.
rows.distinction: A read-only receipt of the serve execution policy's outcome; it decides nothing and is absent on a production serve.
